rationale: The investment in Framework v2, Governance Guard, May Admin, and Content Expansion has produced measurable operational value across all four dimensions. Content production velocity is proven at 21.9 items/hr with zero defects. The admin platform eliminates 7,054 manual cross-references across 30 workflow cases. Governance has achieved zero structural defects in the certified pool (2,317 items) with 9 BLOCK-level rules. However, systematic quality debt (DL-031 difficulty inflation on ~500 items, DL-035 distractor gaps on 39 items) and a content design bottleneck (expansion plateau at score 75) mean the trajectory cannot continue large-scale expansion without addressing these risks. The platform is operationally ready; content quality is the binding constraint.
